groups.saying_opens: لما قدم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مكة

notes: Two sayings: the Ibn Umar account of the Prophet's tawaf, and «أنه قال سنة» with a second isnad («قال شعبة وأخبرني أيوب»), each with its own transmitters (owner ruling 6). The second group continues from Shu'ba as in example 3. «محمد» is written as the text gives it: a bare name, not identified.
